metaDescription: Microsoft Noida Morale Outing team planning portal
footerText: Built for the Noida team · Keep this page handy on the road

home.heroText: Two days away from the usual, with the people who make the work worth it.

location.title: Location & route
location.lede: Everything you need to get from the Microsoft campus to our weekend destination.
location.mapNoteTitle: Open the route in Google Maps
location.mapNoteText: Use live directions on the day of travel to account for traffic. The links open in a new tab.

hotel.lede: A comfortable base for the team, with everything arranged for an easy check-in.

rooms.title: Room allocation
rooms.lede: Find your room, see your roommates and check the remaining capacity at a glance.

travel.title: Travel & cars
travel.lede: Your car, driver and pickup details — all in one place.

team.title: Team members
team.lede: Everyone travelling for the outing, with their technology group and allocations.
team.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, car or room
team.emptyText: No team members match your filters.

event.title: Event information
event.lede: A simple timeline for a relaxed, well-paced weekend together.

gallery.title: Photos & videos
gallery.lede: Relive the weekend. Add your photos and videos to the team folder, and browse everything everyone has shared.
gallery.uploadText: Upload straight from your phone or laptop. You won't see other people's files while uploading — original quality is kept.
gallery.viewText: See everything the team has shared and download your favourites.
tips: Add your name to the file names (or create a folder with your name) so we know who shared what.
Only share photos your colleagues are comfortable with.
Large videos can take a few minutes — keep the page open until the upload finishes.
gallery.accessNote: The links open OneDrive. You may be asked to sign in with your work account.
gallery.homeText: Add your photos and videos from the outing to the team gallery.
